rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday equivalent of “be enough” or “suffice.”

example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sik6 mat6 gau3 m4 gau3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something is adequate for its intended use, especially supplies, money, or time.

example.english: The tissues will suffice until tomorrow, so we don’t need to buy more.
example.traditional: 啲紙巾夠用到聽日，唔使再買喇。
example.jyutping: di1 zi2 gan1 gau3 jung6 dou3 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 zoi3 maai5 laa3
